Canada were DOWN 12 points heading into the 4th quarter against Spain at the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup and then EVERYTHING changed!
With the game on the line, Canada turned up the intensity, made BIG plays on both ends of the floor, and put together an INCREDIBLE fourth-quarter comeback to take down the reigning World Cup champions!
Watch how Canada turned an 12-point deficit into an UNREAL 88-85 victory in one of the biggest games of the 2023 FIBA Basketball World Cup!
